title: Optimal Sensitivity of the general Wheatstone Bridge
summary: Optimizing the sensitivity of the unbalance voltage in Wheatstone bridges with respect to changes in the bridge parameters remains a fundamental objective in circuit design and instrumentation. When finite source and detector resistances are taken into account, determining the optimal bridge configuration becomes increasingly complex, and a closed-form analytical representation of the optimal solution has not yet been established.
